(6) Quarterly after his first three-week vacation, a full-time employee who has completed seven (7) years of continuous full-time service prior to January 1 is eligible for a three-week vacation as of January 1.

(7) A full-time employee will become eligible for a fourth week of vacation upon the fifteenth anniversary of his employment beginning date of continuous full-time service provided he has completed fifteen (15) years of continuous full-time service as of that date.

(8) Quarterly after his first four-week vacation, a full-time employee who has completed fifteen (15) years of continuous full-time service prior to January 1 is eligible for a four-week vacation as of January 1.

(9) A full-time employee will become eligible for a fifth week of vacation as of the twentieth anniversary of his employment beginning date of continuous full-time service provided he has completed twenty (20) years of continuous full-time service as of that date.

(10) Quarterly after his first five-week vacation, a full-time employee who has completed twenty (20) years of continuous full-time service prior to January 1 is eligible for a five-week vacation as of January 1.

If a full-time employee applies for a one (1), two (2), three (3), four (4) or five week vacation as of January 1 and is due to complete the service necessary for an additional week of vacation later in the year, he may take his earned vacation either way and take his cumulative earned vacation later in the year since he must have completed the service necessary for the additional week of vacation.

Effective November 16, 1980, part-time employees who have become full-time after that date, shall have all service full count of time from hire date when considered for calculations concerning vacation and eligibility.

F. If a full-time employee, who has not taken the vacation which he has earned by reason of his service is terminated for any reason except disciplinary reasons, he shall receive his vacation pay as equity at the time of termination.

F. When a holiday included in this Contract occurs during the calendar week of an employee's vacation, the employee, at his option, will be entitled to an extra day of vacation, or an extra day of pay in lieu thereof; however, if the employee requests the extra day he must provide his vacation pay informer of his request.

G. Choice of vacation dates will be granted on the basis of seniority in the market.

H. Employees shall be paid their vacation pay prior to their vacation period.

I. Employees entitled to vacations will not be given pay in lieu thereof, unless mutually agreed to by the Employer, the employee and the Union.

J. After one (1) year of employment, any leave of absence notting tenancy within (90) days or less any leave in any calendar year shall not affect vacation earned in that year; leaves totaling more than ninety (90) days but not over one hundred eighty eight (188) days shall reduce vacation and vacation pay by one-fourth (1/4); leaves totaling more than one hundred eighty eight (188) days but not over two hundred seventy (270) days shall reduce vacation and vacation pay by one-half (1/2); leaves totaling more than two hundred seventy (270) days shall disqualify the employee for vacation for that year only.

K. Should ownership change during the term of this Contract, the present Employer agrees to pay employees for that portion of vacation earned up to date change is made.

ARTICLE III
HOLIDAYS

A. A full holiday shall be given to all full-time non-probability employees covered by this Contract on the following days without reduction in pay:

(1) New Year's Day, Fourth of July, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day, Christmas Day and the employee's anniversary date.

(2) After the completion of one (1) year (only) in employment with Employer, employees shall be entitled to the following additional holidays in accordance with this Contract:

Three (3) personal holidays shall be taken at a time mutually agreed upon between the Employer and the employee. The employee's birthday itself shall also be celebrated as a personal holiday.

Holidays falling on Sunday shall be celebrated the following Monday. When an employee's birthday or anniversary date falls during a holiday week when the employee is not scheduled off day and pay with him will be given the next succeeding non-holiday week end.

B. The following holidays shall be considered as paid holidays for all qualifying part-time employees.

(1) New Year's Day
(2) Fourth of July
(3) Labor Day
(4) Thanksgiving Day
(5) Christmas Day
(6) Employee's Birthday
(7) Employee's Anniversary Date
(8) Employee's Personal Day
(9) Employee's Personal Day
(10) Employee's Personal Day

The following shall govern how holiday pay allowance for the above enumerated holidays be recovered not:

Any employee who shall have received compensation for an average of over twelve (12) hours during the four (4) calendar weeks immediately preceding any such working week in which the holiday falls and, who works during the working week during which the holiday occurs shall receive a holiday pay allowance equal to the average daily hours he has worked during such preceding four (4) calendar weeks, divided by five (5).

When a part-time employee, who is otherwise eligible for holiday pay allowance under the conditions prescribed above is scheduled to work for an employee who has rescheduled a holiday and falls to work, or to work the scheduled day before or day after the holiday, the employee shall receive holiday pay for the day he works.

C. An employee will not receive holiday or birthday pay if he is absent without excuse his scheduled shift hour after the holiday or birthday or his birthday if he is absent without excuse his scheduled shift hour after the holiday or on his birthday or his birthday, if so scheduled. An employee will not lose his holiday or birthday pay if his absence is caused by proven illness, or if his absence has been mutually agreed to, provided he has worked any part of the holiday or birthday. To work on his birthday or holiday or birthday week. The Union agrees that any employee, in order to be eligible for birthday pay, shall give written notice to the Head Meat Cutter during her second week prior to the date of his birthday.

ARTICLE IX
LEAVES OF ABSENCE

A. In case of death of a member of the immediate family of any regular full-time employee, such employee shall be entitled to an excused absence for such time as the Employer deems reasonably necessary in connection with the occurrence. And thereby the first three (3) days' excused absence from his regularity shift shall be with full pay and thereafter any excused absence shall be without hours pay and shall not be considered as hours worked for overtime purposes. No extra pay allowance shall be paid for deaths multiple or simultaneous deaths occurring within any three-service period. No day allowance shall be granted in any case whatever, because of distance, or other cause, the employee foot the expense.

By immediate family is meant to include spouse, son, daughter, mother, father, sister, brother, mother-in-law, father-in-law, grandmother, grandfather-and grandchildren.

B. The Employer agrees to grant the necessary time off without discrimination a reasonable rights and without pay to not more than two (2) employees out one (1) store, and no more than five (5) employees from the Employer, designated by the Union to attend Union business, provided the Employer is given at least one (1) week's notice, in writing, from the Union, specifying the length of time off, and in no case shall the length of time off exceed one (1) year.
